meta.what: Maps every WLC verse (OSHB Book.ch.v) to the YLT and WEB verse(s) that translate it.
meta.hebrew: WLC via OSHB morphhb (same files as the rest of this folder): 23,213 verses.
meta.ylt: ylt.json (eBible.org USFM, public domain). English/KJV versification.
meta.web: World English Bible JSON from github.com/TehShrike/world-english-bible, pinned at commit 68669ba3be9719ae4d1135b19d9e0b6587b7c356. This is the source scripts/build-tanakh.py uses (it fetches master, unpinned). This commit reproduces all 23,011 non-empty `en` fields in HaDay public/tanakh/books/*.json exactly. English/KJV versification, same verse keys as YLT. WEB omits Psalm titles.
meta.method: Standard BHS-vs-English differences written as rules (rules.txt), plus Psalm titles generated from verse counts, plus Ps 13 (found by the content check). Every mapped chapter is checked against the texts: (1) chapter test: content score of the mapping vs the same mapping shifted ±1/±2 verses must be >1.3×; (2) every boundary, split and title verse is checked one by one against its ±2 neighbours, using Strong's proper-noun names, numerals and KJV-gloss words from the Hebrew verse found in the English text; (3) Psalm titles: title words from Hebrew v1 must appear in YLT v1 and score higher there than in v2.

statusValues.needs-review: do not show English for this verse until reviewed
statusValues.same-number: chapter has the same verse division; same number used (all such chapters passed the chapter shift test)

partValues.heading part: YLT verse 1 holds the Psalm title plus English v1; this Hebrew verse is the title part
partValues.body part: this Hebrew verse is the non-title part of YLT v1
partValues.first part: this Hebrew verse is the first part of the English verse
partValues.second part: this Hebrew verse is the end of the English verse

1Sam.21.1.detail: Read by hand: WEB 1Sam 20:42 ends "He arose and departed; and Jonathan went into the city." and YLT 20:42 ends "and he riseth and goeth; and Jonathan hath gone in to the city." = Hebrew 21:1 וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלַךְ וִיהוֹנָתָן בָּא הָעִיר. The automatic score preferred 20:40 only because that verse is short and also has "city".
